title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision 1790042422693: Error: Timed out after 295830ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root 'd31ab16e-918a-4ba6-b8ce-0a5bdfddd7bf'. Last error: <none>.
analysis: The standalone Blazor browser debugger E2E scenario timed out after ~295 seconds waiting for the pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to the Blazor WASM root on Windows. This matches a well-established recurring flaky pattern (29 prior occurrences) in the VS Code extension E2E browser-debugger suite, unrelated to this PR's Azure provisioning proxy changes.
